exposure: Type of cornual pregnancy (interstitial, angular/eccentric intrauterine, rudimentary horn)
outcome: Mode of delivery for subsequent pregnancies
cohort: The study included 62 cases of interstitial, angular/eccentric intrauterine, and rudimentary horn pregnancies at a tertiary perinatal centre.
finding: The study identified frequent occurrences of imprecise nomenclature in diagnosing cornual pregnancies, leading to mismanagement, and highlighted varying ultrasound accuracy and management outcomes for different types.
mod_finding: Among women with interstitial pregnancies who subsequently conceived, nine (75.0%) had Caesarean deliveries.
